HMUR is coming soon to PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam and GoG).

description:

In Endless Legend 2, lead your people to victory on an ever-evolving world in this strategy game featuring asymmetric factions led by powerful heroes. Build your empire, wield political influence, and raise grand armies to wage war in a race to uncover dark secrets buried within the planet.
title: Endless Legend 2 - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
In the second episode of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Hour Zero, Brandon Routh is trying to keep his head above water post-attack in this live-action prequel to the upcoming game. 

Routh plays a "a doctor who saved his enemy" one of three strangers who survvive the opening days of the Republic of Sotoa's invasion of the Federation of Central Usea. 

The prequel sets the stage for the story that players will experience during the Campagin Mode of Ace Combat: Wings of Theve, which releases October 2. 

Tune in over the next two weeks to IGN.com and IGN's YouTube channel for the remianing episodes:

Now Streaming: Act 1
Now Straming: Act 2
Wednesday, September 23: Act 3
Tuesday, September 29: Epilogue
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Hour Zero - Episode 2

author: GameTrailers
description:
A new update brings new freezing elements, arena challenges, weapons, end stats screen, and more to The Rogue Prince of Persia. Watch the latest The Rogue Prince of Persia trailer for the roguelite game to see what to expect from the Anniversary update, which brings new features and reworks. The Rogue Prince of Persia is available now on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation. The Anniversary Update for The Rogue Prince of Persia is available now.

In The Rogue Prince of Persia, every death is a unique chance to rewrite fate, save Persia – or die trying. Explore and platform in a shifting kingdom imagined by developer Evil Empire, master an acrobatic combat style, and meet new allies as you fight to rewrite the fate of your people.
title: The Rogue Prince of Persia - Official Anniversary Update Launch Trailer

description: Check out the PS5 & PC Announcement Trailer for Zero Parades: Director’s Cut, the definitive edition of the hit narrative-based espionage RPG developed by ZA/UM. Players will embark on a desperate final mission to make sense of the lies and make a grand stand on the world stage. The Zero Parades: Director’s Cut is packed with a suite of improvements, a new story, Backstage Mode, and more to enjoy. Zero Parades: Director’s Cut is launcing on October 1 for PC (Steam) as a free update, with a release on PlayStation 5 (PS5) on November 3.

description:

You play Hope Song, a 17 year old student who returns home to find her family apartment ransacked and her parents missing. Hope In The City launches on November 10th for Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, Xbox on PC)

#HopeInTheCity #Gaming #IGN

Master the arts of combat, unlock powerful magical abilities, and team up with friends in local or online co-op to restore magic to the shattered world of Talamh. Absolum is available now on Nintendo Switch 2. It is also available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), and Nintendo Switch.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Celebrate Dying Light: The Beast's anniversary with a new event marking one year since players first stepped into Castor Woods. Check out the latest Dying Light: The Beast trailer for the FPS to see what's coming with the in-game anniversary event built around global community goals. The event also features gameplay modifiers and rewards inspired by Castor Woods. Each week, players will work together to complete shared objectives and unlock exclusive anniversary bonuses. During the event period, you can also log in daily to claim new gifts on the Outpost landing page, including in-game items, digital treats, and more. 

The Dying Light: The Beast is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic Games Store. The Dying Light: The Beast in-game anniversary event runs from September 21 to October 12, 2026.

#DyingLightTheBeast #AnniversaryEvent #Gaming

Flamecraft is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).

description: Take a look at gameplay from Spaceborn: Awakening in this trailer for the upcoming narrative-driven bullet-heaven roguelite game. In Spaceborn: Awakening, start as a mortal. A demo is out now.
title: Spaceborn: Awakening - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Mimic Busters announcement trailer for this upcoming stealth party game. In Mimic Busters, matches pit agents from the Mimic Bureau of Investigation against player-created props standing around the room. Hiding players start each round with an empty cube and limited time. Using basic push, pull, and paint tools, they shape the block into an object that fits the room, such as a chair, desk lamp, or bookshelf. To keep matches moving, all hiding players automatically emit a squeak sound every 30 seconds, giving away audio clues.

Mimic Busters will be available on PC via Steam in 2026.
title: Mimic Busters - Official Announcement Trailer

PHYSINT is still a ways off but we now know the lead character will be played by Bill Skarsgaard, with supporting cast members: Charlee Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe!
